name: Athenium Institute — Academia LMS Home
description: A mobile-first learning-platform homepage for a demo academy called Athenium Institute. Warm paper-ivory surfaces with deep indigo-plum ink, a terracotta accent, and Fraunces serif display over Inter and Space Mono. The page opens with a live announcement ribbon, a serif hero with count-up stats, and a six-course catalog you can search and filter by category with instant empty-state feedback. The flagship course dossier opens an expandable curriculum (three modules, twelve lessons) with per-lesson tracking, module progress, and an SVG progress ring that persists across reloads. An instructor spotlight, three pricing tiers, and three testimonials build trust, then a validated enrollment form (name, email, course, track) bumps a persisted campus seat counter, rejects duplicates kindly, and offers an add-to-calendar .ics export with clipboard fallback. A live certificate preview renders the learner's name into a printable certificate the moment it is typed. Includes toast notifications, a mobile sticky enroll bar, back-to-top, reveal-on-scroll with reduced-motion support, and complete data-fws-slot content annotations for the business.education vocabulary.
features: announcement ribbon with pause, resume, and dismiss
serif hero with live count-up stat strip
searchable, category-filterable course catalog with empty state
one-click add-to-plan enrollment on each course card
expanding curriculum dossier with per-lesson progress and persisted progress ring
three pricing tiers with a highlighted plan
validated enrollment form with course and track choices, duplicates, and reset
persisted campus seat counter with social-proof avatar stack
live certificate preview with print action
toast notifications, mobile enroll bar, and back-to-top
fully customizable content via data-fws-slot attributes
